products.name: Legendary Treasures Sleeved Booster Pack Art Bundle [Set of 4]
products.note: One sleeved pack of each of the four wrappers (TCGplayer: "Collect each of the 4 unique art packs").

products.name: Legendary Treasures Three Pack Blister [Eevee]
products.note: Three packs, a coin and BW97 Eevee, the first promo on Smooth Cosmos Holofoil (Bulbapedia merchandise page and pkmn.gg variant text).

products.name: Legendary Treasures Three Pack Blister [Mew]
products.note: Three packs, a coin and BW98 Mew in Smooth Cosmos Holo (Bulbapedia merchandise page and pkmn.gg variant text).

products.name: Legendary Treasures Single Pack Blister [Aggron]
products.note: One pack and a Smooth Cosmos Holo reprint of Dragons Exalted' Aggron (single source; the reprint card is not simulated).

products.name: Legendary Treasures Single Pack Blister [Ampharos]
products.note: One pack and a Smooth Cosmos Holo reprint of Dragons Exalted' Ampharos (single source; the reprint card is not simulated).

products.name: Legendary Dragons of Unova Collection
products.note: Four Black & White Series packs (set not named: dealt as Legendary Treasures), three figures and Cosmos Holo reprints of Reshiram, Zekrom and Kyurem (not simulated). TCGplayer id and Bulbapedia.

products.name: Black & White Two Pack Blister [Legendary Birds]
products.note: Two Black & White Series packs (set not named: dealt as Legendary Treasures) and Cosmos Holo reprints of Moltres, Articuno and Zapdos (not simulated). Bulbapedia only, December 2013.

products.name: Black & White Two Pack Blister [Swords of Justice]
products.note: Two Black & White Series packs (set not named: dealt as Legendary Treasures) and Cosmos Holo reprints of Virizion, Terrakion and Cobalion (not simulated). Bulbapedia only, December 2013.

products.name: Best of Black & White Tin [Mewtwo-EX]
products.note: November 2013 re-release of the first tins: four packs, typically one Plasma Blast, one Plasma Freeze and two Plasma Storm (Bulbapedia only: low). The EX promo is the same card as the first release (filed with that tin's set) and is not simulated.
